description: This PHP file defines a class ECB within the OpenCart admin extension, specifically handling currency exchange rate integration with the European Central Bank (ECB). It includes methods for displaying configuration pages, saving settings, and fetching currency rates from the ECB XML feed.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for managing ECB currency exchange rates within OpenCart's admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the ECB currency configuration page, including breadcrumbs and header/footer loading.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of ECB currency settings, including permission checking and JSON response.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest exchange rates from the ECB XML feed, updates currency values in the database, and clears cache.
